answer: To enter consensus, a fresh identity must post a refundable 500-unit bond in jade and finish a voyage of twelve consecutive epochs of peer-attested, hash-unique answers. Any copied or near-duplicate text slashes 10% of that bond and restarts the twelve-epoch clock; unbonding then takes six quiet epochs during which the same key cannot open another identity. A sybil operator therefore has to immobilize an ocean of reserve capital for months on every replica, which is more expensive than earning standing through genuine attested work.
